unavailableFeatures.reason: No upstream Inventory Profiles Next / libIPN NeoForge artifact with matching internal Minecraft 26.1 dependency constraints was found. Modrinth compatibility tags differ from JAR metadata; unsupported files are not installed.

No official NeoForge Minecraft 26.1 VeinMiner artifact supports the pinned NeoForge 26.1.0.19-beta event API. All listed releases directly reference net.neoforged.neoforge.event.level.block.BreakBlockEvent, absent from this runtime (which exposes BlockEvent$BreakEvent). VeinMiner, its dependent Hotkey, and unused KotlinLangForge are not installed.
